title: A Will for the Letter
author: Noor Zhou
blurb: Silas Thackeray, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
